Deep in {wiki:Demona|Demona}, full of {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}, there is a bookshelf room where two maps and a rare book are hidden. Make your way to Demona, find the bookshelf room and search the shelves for the {item:Tibia Map (Book)|Tibia Map}, the {item:Fields of Glory Map (Book)|Fields of Glory Map} and the {item:Purple Tome}.
Know the way to Demona: follow section 1 (the {wiki:Route: Demona|standard route to Demona}); on the way you pass the level 60 **Gate of Expertise** in the Maze of Lost Souls.
to open the entrance hole south of Northport
to climb out through the holes if you leave the same way
The {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} are the biggest danger in Demona: they turn invisible, summon and hit hard from a distance. Go prepared with potions and, if possible, in a team.
Also count on all the creatures you meet on the way to Demona.
Go to the cave south of Northport
Leave **Carlin** to the north, to the cave a little **south** of Northport. Bring a {item:Shovel} and a {item:Rope}.
Open the hole with the shovel
Use the {item:Shovel} at this spot to dig a hole and go in.
Follow the **blue line** on the map to the next hole.
Route to the next hole (blue line)

Keep following the blue line until you find a small grove inside the cave. At the **red** spot, behind the trees, there is a hole: go down and flip the lever inside to the **right** to open the MoLS entrance. Then leave the hole.
Red spot: hole with the lever, behind the trees
If the lever is already flipped to the right, flip it to the left and then to the right again.
Follow this path to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls. You will have to cross some {item:Energy Field|Energy Fields}.
Energy Fields drain your health when you cross them: go through with full health.

Inside the MoLS, follow the map step by step. In the first entrance room is the {wiki:Griffin Shield Quest|Griffin Shield Quest}. Keep going to the end of the passage and cross the level 60 **Gate of Expertise**.
Stay on the path: off it there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.
After the Gate of Expertise go **north** and always follow the **right-hand** passage to the stairs. Right above is {wiki:Demona|Demona} and the main star-shaped room, the **Star Room**.
Use the northwest stairs of the Star Room

In Demona you will find several {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}. In the **Star Room**, use the **northwest** stairs, the ones that lead to the exit teleport, and go down to the floor below.
Stairs northwest of the Star Room

Demona is far below the {wiki:Fields of Glory|Fields of Glory}, north of Carlin, beneath the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls|Maze of Lost Souls} (MoLS). This path is the {wiki:Route: Demona|standard route to Demona} and starts in the cave a little south of {wiki:Northport|Northport}, a small village north of Carlin.
Keep following the path and turn onto the **first path north** until you reach a room full of bookshelves.
The bookshelf room with the maps and the Purple Tome
This room is the spawn point of one of the only two {creature:Infernalist|Infernalists} in Demona (the other is on the floor above).
Search the bookshelves in the room: there you find the two maps and the tome.
Teleport to the Fields of Glory

To leave faster, go back **south** to the main path, keep going **west** and then turn **south**. There is a teleport there that takes you to the surface, in the middle of the {wiki:Fields of Glory|Fields of Glory}. From there walk **south** back to **Carlin**.
Exit teleport to the Fields of Glory
Alternative: going back through the Maze of Lost Souls

If you prefer, retrace the path to the Star Room and go down to the MoLS. Follow the path on this map to get out of the maze and then leave the cave the **same way you came in**, using the {item:Rope} on the holes, up to the surface south of Northport.
Exit route from the Maze of Lost Souls
